title: The Forsaken Immortal Clan
summary: In the Land of the Forsaken Immortals, Wang Lin learns that the 'savages' are the Forsaken Immortal Clan, divided into curse spell masters and war curse masters whose power grows with the number of leaves in their runes. He kills the five-leaf spell master Momo, then meets the six-leaf master Ka Mo, who tells him Planet Suzaku was once their home until the Suzaku Country rose to rank six and the Cultivation Alliance gave it the planet; the war that followed killed ninety percent of the clan. Ka Mo warns him that seven-leaf masters, equal to Soul Transformation, wait on the third level. Wang Lin rescues the wounded Sun Dian, who gives him an Ancient Bell to bring him along to the Reincarnation Tree. At the tree, three Reincarnation Fruits appear after Sun Dian sacrifices his two disciples' lifespans, and the six-leaf war curse master Chi Mu arrives.
